jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Consultant
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description:
About The Job You Are Considering

Capgemini’s Insights & Data practice helps leading organizations harness data to drive innovation, efficiency, and transformation. With a focus on Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, and emerging Agentic AI technologies, we help clients create intelligent solutions that deliver measurable business outcomes.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Full Stack Developer to design, build, modernize, and support enterprise-grade digital platforms and mission-critical business applications. The role combines hands-on engineering with technical leadership across frontend, backend, integration, cloud-native deployment, and DevOps practices.

The successful candidate will translate business needs into secure, scalable solutions, establish reusable engineering standards, contribute to architecture governance, and mentor development teams throughout the software delivery lifecycle.

Your Role

Full Stack Engineering & Solution Design


Design, develop, test, and maintain secure, scalable, and highly available full stack applications.
Translate business and functional requirements into technical designs, architecture decisions, and delivery plans.
Build cloud-native solutions using microservices, stateless service patterns, containerization, and API-first principles.
Contribute to solution architecture reviews, technology selection, engineering standards, and platform roadmaps.
Remain hands-on in coding, troubleshooting, technical spikes, and resolution of complex production issues.


Frontend Engineering


Develop responsive Single Page Applications using Python, React, Next.js, TypeScript, and modern web standards.
Build reusable component libraries and design systems using tools such as Tailwind CSS, Radix, or ShadCN.
Implement role-based dashboards, accessible interfaces, reusable state and data-fetching patterns, and responsive workflows.
Optimize frontend performance, usability, maintainability, browser compatibility, and accessibility.


Backend, APIs & Workflow Automation


Design and develop backend services and microservices using Java, Spring Boot, Node.js, or NestJS.
Build REST and SOAP services, enterprise integration layers, background processing, and event-driven workflows.
Implement authentication, authorization, role-based access control, audit logging, idempotency, and exception handling.
Design configurable business workflows, approval processes, task orchestration, and regulatory process automation.


Enterprise Integration & Data


Integrate internal platforms, external service providers, and enterprise applications.
Implement synchronous and asynchronous integrations using REST, SOAP, or equivalent messaging technologies.
Design data models and persistence services using PostgreSQL, Snowflake, Oracle, MySQL, or equivalent relational databases.
Apply sound practices for transactions, data integrity, query optimization, integration resiliency, and failure recovery.
Have very good understanding of transaction and analytical data models.


Cloud, DevOps & Operational Excellence


Package and deploy applications using Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, and Helm.
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using GitLab, Jenkins, or equivalent platforms.
Implement structured logging, monitoring, alerting, health checks, and operational dashboards.
Improve release reliability through automated build, test, security scanning, deployment, and rollback practices.
Contribute to infrastructure automation and environment consistency using Infrastructure as Code where applicable.


Technical Leadership & Collaboration


Mentor engineers, conduct code and design reviews, and promote consistent software engineering practices.
Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, architects, QA, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and release teams.
Lead technical estimation, sprint planning, dependency management, risk resolution, and delivery governance.
Produce clear architecture decisions, technical documentation, API specifications, operational runbooks, and knowledge-transfer materials.


AI-Assisted Engineering


Use approved AI-assisted development tools to improve delivery productivity, documentation, testing, and code quality.
Establish governed AI-assisted workflows that retain human review, security, compliance, traceability, and intellectual property controls.
Assess emerging engineering tools and recommend practical adoption patterns aligned with enterprise standards.


Your Skills And Experience


Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Software engineering experience, and proven experience delivering full stack applications.
Proven delivery of enterprise-scale, high-availability, or mission-critical digital platforms.
Hands-on experience building cloud-native and microservices-based solutions.
Experience leading technical delivery, mentoring engineers, and working in Agile environments.
Strong problem-solving, stakeholder communication, documentation, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
Must have experience with mobile application development and responsive application development.
Experience with content management systems is good to have.


Capability Expected experience

Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, SPA architecture, responsive UI, component-driven design

Backend: Java, Spring Boot, Spring Security, JPA/Hibernate, Node.js, NestJS or Express.js, microservices

APIs & Integration: REST, SOAP, API design, asynchronous messaging, event-driven architecture, IBM MQ or Oracle AQ

Data: PostgreSQL, Oracle or MySQL, relational modeling, SQL performance tuning, transaction management

Cloud & DevOps: Docker, Kubernetes or OpenShift, Helm, GitLab CI/CD or Jenkins, logging and monitoring

Engineering Practices: Git, code reviews, design patterns, automated testing, secure coding, Agile delivery, technical documentation

Why you should consider Capgemini

Growing clients’ businesses while building a more sustainable, more inclusive future is a tough ask. When you join Capgemini, you’ll join a thriving company and become part of a collective of free-thinkers, entrepreneurs, and industry experts. We find new ways technology can help us reimagine what’s possible. It’s why, together, we seek out opportunities that will transform the world’s leading businesses, and it’s how you’ll gain the experiences and connections you need to shape your future.

By learning from each other every day, sharing knowledge, and always pushing yourself to do better, you’ll build the skills you want. You’ll use your skills to help our clients leverage technology to innovate and grow their business. So, it might not always be easy, but making the world a better place rarely is.

About Capgemini

Capgemini is an AI-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organisations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end-to-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering, and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22.5 billion. Make it real | www.capgemini.com.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (TypeScript, Next.js / Node.js) (m/f/x)
jobs.description:
Atolls is the world’s largest community-driven shopping platform, active in 20+ markets.

We help millions make smarter spending decisions across discovery, evaluation, and (re-)purchase by connecting people with the right brands and retailers.

Our 1,000+ team across 10 countries builds products used every day at global scale, where you’ll have real ownership and see your impact. Want to shape the destinations people rely on to shop with confidence? Keep reading.

About This Role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (TypeScript, Next.js / Node.js) to join our Engineering team in Berlin or working remotely from Germany. At Atolls, your role will play a key role in helping us provide a seamless web experience that enables users to find the Smart Shopping capability that best matches their intent through search, navigation, and a personalized home page, creating exceptional user experiences and empowering consumers to make informed and confident shopping decisions. As a key part of our team, you’ll be directly involved in building and enhancing the digital destinations our users rely on throughout their shopping journeys.

Your contributions will help shape how millions of consumers interact with our platforms, guiding them to make smart, fair, and rewarding choices.

Our Benefits:

At Atolls, we believe in nurturing both your professional and personal growth. Here’s what you can expect:


A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.
These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.



Responsibilities:

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will:


Design and develop modern architectures using NEXT.JS, AWS technologies, Microservices, NoSQL, and event-driven architectures.
Take ownership of solution architecture, improving performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency.
Drive feature development from inception to delivery, contributing to an ambitious product roadmap.
Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions and hands-on exposure to emerging technologies.
Foster an open communication culture, encouraging feedback and supporting conflict resolution.



Your Profile:


6+ years of experience in software development.
Proficiency in Next.js / Node.js, with experience building reusable libraries using an atomic design system.
Strong foundation in object-oriented programming and concurrent event-based systems.
Advanced knowledge of TypeScript, including its environment and type system.
Extensive expertise in GraphQL.
Keen architectural mindset with an eye for application design patterns.
Excellent communication skills with fluency in English (written and spoken).



Desirable Skills:


Working knowledge of Apollo GraphQL.
Experience with PHP Symfony.
Experience working with AWS cloud.
Basic understanding of SQL databases and schema-less concepts.
Knowledge of E2E testing (e.g., WebdriverIO, Selenium, or similar tools).



Our hiring process:


TA Call: Meet one of our Talent Experts and get to know Atolls better.
Technical Round: Focus on the technical aspects of the role (Through a Live Case), and meet your potential manager.
Final Round: Meet other Atollians 🏝️ It varies from 1 to 3 interviews
Some processes might slightly change according to needs



Ready to apply?

Be part of a destination where your work helps millions of people make better decisions every day. One focused application is all we need. If you truly fit more than one role, you’re welcome to apply to up to three. This helps us match you with the right opportunity faster.

We review every application with equal care and will reach out if your profile aligns. Apply now with your CV in English.

At Atolls, we want to ensure that all employees can thrive in an inclusive environment. Our employment opportunities are open to every gender, race, religion, age, sexual orientation, ability, place of origin, or socioeconomic status. We remain committed to a culture of diversity, equity and belonging, where all employees are welcomed, respected, connected, and engaged.

As part of our recruitment process at Atolls, we use AI tools for interview recording and transcription. These tools are designed to assist our teams and are never used independently to make hiring decisions. Every assessment and hiring decision is made by our hiring panel and team through human judgment.

Before your first interview, you will receive an email with the option to opt out. You can also change your preference at any time during the recruitment process by using the link in that email or by contacting your Talent Acquisition Partner.

The use of AI, or the choice not to use it, will not affect your application in any way.

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer - ClickPipes Platform
jobs.description:
About The Team

The ClickPipes Platform plays a critical role in driving the growth of our company and ensuring the success of our clients by seamlessly onboarding and integrating data from diverse data sources into ClickHouse. Working at a petabyte scale and in high-velocity environments, this role offers an exceptional opportunity to solve challenging technical problems, operate with significant autonomy, and make a measurable impact.

Working on ClickPipes offers the opportunity to operate with a high degree of ownership and autonomy, tackle ambiguous problems, and deliver features that are used by some of the most data-intensive companies in the world.

You can find some of the teams recent work highlighted in our blog:


Flexible Scaling and Monitoring in ClickPipes
MySQL CDC Connector for ClickPipes
The Evolution of ClickPipes


As a Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you’ll design and build complex, data-heavy user interfaces and own customer-facing workflows end-to-end. While this role has a strong frontend focus, engineers are expected to work comfortably across the whole stack, collaborating on backend services, APIs, and system integrations as needed. We’re looking for T-shaped engineers who bring deep frontend expertise while remaining pragmatic and effective beyond UI tasks.

What will you do?


Build scalable UI systems that handle large datasets, async operations, and real-time state changes
Own features end-to-end, from initial design through production launch and long-term maintenance
Collaborate closely with product, design, and other engineering teams to deliver new features
Partner on API design and system contracts
Participate in an on-call rotation to support ClickPipes in production, helping diagnose incidents, and mitigate issues
Take ownership of production quality, including monitoring, debugging, performance tuning, and reliability improvements


What You Will Bring


5+ years of experience building and shipping production full-stack applications
In-depth knowledge of web fundamentals (HTML/CSS, JavaScript, DOM, HTTP)
Solid experience in designing and building applications with React and TypeScript
Experience writing and maintaining automated tests (unit, integration, and E2E) as part of a CI/CD workflow
Practical knowledge of backend systems, REST and/or GraphQL APIs, and service-oriented architecture
Great communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a distributed, async-friendly team


Nice To Have


Familiarity with Go, Node, or other server-side languages
Familiarity with cloud infrastructure concepts and infrastructure-as-code tools such as Terraform
Experience working on data-intensive products or platforms at scale


Why Join Us


Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology at the intersection of data engineering and cloud-native infrastructure.
Be part of a high-visibility team integral to the company’s success.
Operate with autonomy, ownership, and the ability to drive meaningful impact in a rapidly evolving space.


Perks


Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.
Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.
Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.
Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.
A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.
Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.


Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

ClickHouse provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type based on factors such as race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Please see here for our Privacy Statement.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Backend
jobs.description:
Property Finder is the leading property portal in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, dedicated to shaping an inclusive future for real estate while spearheading the region’s growing tech ecosystem. At its core is a clear and powerful purpose: To change living for good in the region.




Founded on the value of great ambitions, Property Finder connects millions of property seekers with thousands of real estate professionals every day. The platform offers a seamless and enriching experience, empowering both buyers and renters to make informed decisions. Since its inception in 2007, Property Finder has evolved into a trusted partner for developers, brokers, and home seekers. As a lighthouse tech company, it continues to create an environment where people can thrive and contribute meaningfully to the transformation of real estate in MENA.




Role Summary




We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team behind the surfaces that bring millions of people to Property Finder every month — search, property and location content, and the platforms that serve them across multiple countries and languages.

This is high-traffic, consumer-facing, and unusually unforgiving: page latency, cache behaviour, and data correctness are not just engineering quality metrics here, they directly move organic acquisition and revenue. You'll work close to the numbers and see the impact of your decisions in production within days.

It's a hands-on senior role. You'll design and own services end to end, influence architecture beyond your squad, and raise the bar for the engineers around you.




Key Responsibilities




Design, build, and operate the backend services powering our highest-traffic consumer surfaces.
Own your work end to end: design, implementation, testing, deployment, observability, and the follow-up iteration based on what production actually tells you.
Build new services and features in TypeScript (Node.js), and maintain and evolve our existing Go services.
Work at the edges of the system — caching, CDN behaviour, content delivery, and rendering paths — where small changes have outsized effects on cost and performance.
Build for multiple countries and languages from day one: content, localisation, and market-specific behaviour are the default, not an afterthought.
Partner with product, SEO, data, and web/mobile engineers to turn requirements into systems that stay maintainable after the first release.
Drive operational excellence: monitoring, alerting, incident response, and continuous improvement of reliability, latency, and infrastructure cost.
Mentor engineers, review designs and PRs properly, and shape our backend standards.




Desired Qualifications




Must have 5+ years of backend engineering, with significant time on high-traffic, consumer-facing systems.
Strong TypeScript (Node.js) — the primary language for all new work.
Go, or a track record that says you'll pick it up fast. Our existing production services are in Go and you'll own them alongside new development.
Experience designing and operating services in a distributed environment: API design, service boundaries, versioning, and inter-service communication — plus the judgement to know when not to split something.

jobs.description:
Our vision

Short-term rental operators are drowning in scattered tools, missed guest messages, and manual work. We're building one system that runs it all — from guest communication and reservations to cleaning, maintenance, pricing, and reporting, powered by AI.

Base360.ai is on a mission to become the operating system that short-term rental businesses around the world run on. We help property managers automate operations, increase revenue, and scale their portfolios without growing their workload.

We're early, we're moving fast, and we're looking for people who want to help build something huge from the ground up.

About The Role

We're looking for a Founding Growth Marketer to help Base360 reach short-term rental operators and property management companies — and turn attention into demo bookings, qualified leads, and customers.

We're open to how you get there: you might go deep and own a single channel, or run across several. Paid ads, SEO, outbound, content, partnerships, lifecycle, funnels — we want someone who can find what works and make it grow.

This is a hands-on, entrepreneurial role. You'll work directly with the founder, experiment quickly, and build our growth engine from the ground up.

What You'll Do


Own a growth channel end to end — or run across several. Set the strategy, launch campaigns, and take responsibility for results.
Generate qualified leads and drive demo bookings. Build campaigns that reach short-term rental operators through paid ads, SEO, outbound, referrals, and industry partnerships.
Understand our customers. Learn how property managers operate, what slows them down, and what makes them switch software.
Run experiments fast. Test hooks, audiences, funnels, and offers; stop what doesn't work and scale what does.
Use AI wherever it gives you an edge. Apply it to research, copy, targeting, content production, and automation.
Build funnels and landing pages that convert. Improve each step from first impression to demo booking and paying customer.
Work closely with the founder on positioning and messaging. Turn product capabilities into clear reasons for operators to choose Base360.
Track performance. Measure lead quality, conversion rates, acquisition costs, and pipeline contribution — and explain what's working and why.


Who You Are


You're a fast learner. You may specialise in one growth channel or work across many, but you pick up new skills quickly and enjoy figuring things out.
You're hungry to get great at growth. You don't need to know everything yet, but you're determined to become one of the best.
You're AI-savvy. You use modern tools to test ideas, automate repetitive work, and move faster.
You're resourceful and self-directed. You take a goal and figure out how to achieve it without waiting for detailed instructions.
You're analytical. You're comfortable with data, attribution, and turning insight into action.
You care about commercial results. You measure success through qualified demand and customers, not just impressions and clicks.
Bonus: Hands-on experience with paid ads, SEO, outbound, content, lifecycle marketing, or partnerships.
Bonus: Experience in B2B SaaS, short-term rentals, hospitality technology, or marketing to property managers.


Why join Base360.ai?


Help build the AI operating system for short-term rental businesses.
Work directly with the founder and shape how we bring the product to market.
Have ownership from day one, with the opportunity to build and lead a growth team.
Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
Grow professionally in a hands-on, entrepreneurial environment where your work directly affects the business.


You Should NOT Apply If


You're looking for a predictable corporate role with a fixed playbook.
You engage in office politics or gossip instead of communicating directly.
You're looking for a slow-paced role with limited ownership.
You don't aim to become one of the best at what you do.

jobs.title: Experienced / Senior Fullstack Engineer (Productivity)
jobs.description:
Notre mission ⚖️

Chez Doctrine, nous construisons le leader de l’IA juridique en Europe.

Notre conviction ? Le droit ne doit pas être ralenti par des tâches répétitives. Il doit être augmenté par une IA spécialisée, conçue pour comprendre, analyser et produire du raisonnement juridique avec un haut niveau d’exigence.

Notre ambition ? Permettre aux professionnels du droit de gagner en fiabilité, en efficacité et en sérénité, grâce à une plateforme unique, exhaustive et sécurisée.

Aujourd’hui, 27 000 professionnels du droit, répartis dans cinq pays (France, Italie, Allemagne, Espagne, Luxembourg), nous font confiance.

Notre développement est guidé par une approche claire : une vision globale, ancrée dans une compréhension fine des spécificités locales.

Derrière cette ambition, une équipe d’environ 250 personnes, réunies autour d’un même objectif : accompagner les juristes et avocats à toutes les étapes de leur travail, de l’analyse à la rédaction.

Et nous n’en sommes qu’au début.

Le contexte

La squad Productivity est au cœur de la transformation produit autour de la gestion des affaires contentieuses de bout en bout.

Le scope de la squad s'est considérablement enrichi, au-delà du seul gain de productivité, en allant vers l'accompagnement de la réflexion et de l'argumentation juridique, à travers plusieurs langues.

Aujourd’hui, elle est responsable de toute la chaîne de valeur :


Analyse de documents
Rédaction automatisée des conclusions et documents juridiques
Réflexion stratégique sur l’argumentation


C’est le cœur de notre IA appliquée au raisonnement juridique : travail avancé sur les modèles LLM, le machine learning et la structuration de documents complexes.1.

Tu peux trouver des détails sur l’ensemble de la stack sur Github !

A savoir : il n’est pas nécessaire d’avoir une expérience professionnelle dans le domaine du droit, cependant l’envie de s’investir et de monter en compétence dans la compréhension des documents juridique est importante :)

Les missions 🛠


Concevoir et développer des features produit de bout en bout — de la modélisation back-end à l'interface utilisateur, en ownership complet sur tes sujets.
Intégrer des modèles d'IA et LLM dans les flux produit — pour enrichir l'expérience des avocats et juristes qui utilisent Doctrine au quotidien.
Maintenir et faire évoluer notre architecture cloud — stack moderne, scalabilité, fiabilité des services en production.
Participer activement aux choix techniques de ta squad — revues de code, décisions d'architecture, amélioration continue de la qualité du code.
Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes Produit et Design — pour transformer des problèmes métier complexes en solutions techniques concrètes et utiles.
Contribuer à la roadmap technique transverse — outillage, dette technique, documentation, et montée en compétences collective.


Le profil idéal 👀


Tu maîtrises TypeScript/JavaScript côté back et front, et tu es à l'aise sur une stack moderne en production (Node.js, React ou équivalent).
Tu as une vraie culture backend — modélisation de données, APIs robustes, performance, gestion de la dette technique. Le front ne te fait pas peur, mais c'est le back qui te définit.
Tu es autonome et orienté ownership — tu prends un sujet, tu le cadres, tu le livres. Tu n'attends pas qu'on te dise quoi faire.
Tu travailles bien avec le Produit — tu comprends le besoin utilisateur, tu sais challenger un spec, et tu penses impact avant technologie.
Tu as une appétence pour l'IA — tu n'es pas forcément expert LLM, mais tu t'y intéresses activement et tu vois comment ça transforme les produits.
Tu aimes partager et faire grandir les autres — revues de code constructives, documentation, pair programming. Tu laisses la codebase meilleure qu'à ton arrivée.


Les à côtés du poste 👁


Comme tous les ingénieurs de Doctrine, tu participeras à un de nos chapters transverse, en l’espèce le chapter Web. Au sein de ce chapter, tu contribueras à des projets internes pour améliorer nos process et notre vision long-terme. Le chapter se réunit toutes les semaines pour :
🤝 Partager des connaissances : suivit de l’état de l’art, revue de papiers scientifiques, amélioration continue, bonnes pratiques,…
🎯 Proposer des évolutions : nouveaux outils à expérimenter, nouveaux process à mettre en œuvre
Tu participeras également au 👩‍💻 recrutement : tous les contributeurs individuels rencontrent des candidats à l’occasion de tests techniques ou d’entretiens.


Ce qui t'attend si tu rejoins Doctrine 🤝


Contribuer à un projet ambitieux, avec un impact réel et positif sur la société : rendre le droit plus accessible et plus ouvert.
Un onboarding très complet permettant une intégration et une montée en compétence rapides.
Une aventure dans laquelle la formation et le partage des connaissances font partis du quotidien.
Rejoindre une entreprise avec une vie d’équipe riche et dynamique : conférences, team-buildings, déjeuner, offsite, afterwork, etc.


Nos valeurs 🤝

Chez Doctrine, nos 4 valeurs nous accompagnent au quotidien et dans notre ambition de faire bouger les choses.


Challenge the status quo : nous défendons les idées audacieuses qui contribuent à l’évolution de tout un secteur.
Liberty and responsibility : nous encourageons l’autonomie, l’impact de chacun·e et l’ownership.
Knowledge is power : l'information est au cœur de la mission de Doctrine, et nous cherchons constamment à progresser.
Release early, release often and listen to your customers : nous croyons au pouvoir de l’itération et à l’importance d’écouter en permanence notre marché, nos client·e·s et leurs problématiques.


Nos avantages pour faire la différence ☀️

🏡 Une politique de télétravail flexible permettant - selon les équipes - jusqu’à trois jours de télétravail par semaine.

🌴 Une politique de congés flexibles

🌱 Des opportunités concrètes de mobilité interne

🏄‍♂️ Des évènements collectifs réguliers

📚 Un vrai accent sur la formation individuelle et collective, avec un budget annuel de 750€ pour toute formation en lien avec ton poste - et des formations en équipe ou pour toute l'entreprise

🏋️‍♀️ Un abonnement Gymlib pour les activités sportives et bien-être

🧘 Un accès gratuit à la plateforme d'accompagnement à la santé mentale Moka.care et un accompagnement individuel allant jusqu’à 6 séances par an

👩‍⚕️ Une assurance santé avec Alan

🍱 🚲 Une carte Swile pour tes tickets restaurants et ton forfait mobilité durable (66,60 euros par mois)

💡 Des réductions et avantages négociés grâce à notre CSE via la plateforme Happypal

🍏 Un équipement de travail neuf chez Apple

Notre processus de recrutement 🚀


Un premier échange de 30 min avec l’un.e de nos Talent Acquisition Manager pour bien comprendre ton projet professionnel et te présenter ce qu'on construit chez Doctrine
Une rencontre d’1h avec ton/ta futur.e manager, pour détailler le poste et le scope de l’équipe, mais aussi répondre à toutes tes questions.
Un ou deux tests techniques pour évaluer concrètement tes compétences
Une venue dans nos bureaux pour : un déjeuner avec 3 personnes de différents départements chez Doctrine, pour te donner un aperçu de tes futur.e.s collègues ; un échange sur les valeurs de l’entreprise pour te partager notre vision, et une rencontre avec notre CEO, Guillaume.


(si nécessaire le processus pourra être adapté pour répondre à tes contraintes personnelles et professionnelles)

Mesdames, autorisez-vous à candidater !

Certaines études scientifiques montrent qu'en particulier les femmes ont moins tendance à postuler à une offre d'emploi quand elles n'ont pas toutes les qualifications. Si cela peut vous rassurer, sachez que cette fiche de poste est indicative donc prenez la comme telle : c'est un guide, ni plus ni moins.

Si Doctrine vous intéresse, sachez que nous aurons plaisir à recevoir votre candidature !

Diversité & inclusion

Toutes nos offres sont ouvertes aux personnes en situation de handicap, n'hésitez pas a nous en parler

About Settify

Settify, an AI-backed technology, helps legal clients in preparing and presenting their personal stories effectively. It streamlines the initial information-gathering process, helping clients articulate key details when seeking legal assistance, particularly in areas like family law and wills. Collecting new client information can involve significant time and cost spent on both sides. Using Settify saves time, increases the accuracy of their work and ultimately, helps their clients by reducing their costs and increases their chance of success in their matters.

Settify is a member of the LEAP group of companies - the leading provider of Legal Practice Management Solutions in the world. Over a 30-year period we've expanded across Australia, Canada, the United States, the United Kingdom, the Republic of Ireland, Poland and New Zealand and support more than 70,000 lawyers and their staff in small and medium sized law firms. We owe our success to our curiosity and commitment to our guiding purpose, to 'Help lawyers who help people'.




What you'll do

As a pivotal member of the team, you'll help shape the development of an AI-driven legal product that provides users with intelligent tools for managing their legal information. You'll be instrumental in rebuilding the entire application from the ground up, making it fully customisable and content-driven to streamline legal client intake and case preparation.

This will involve integrating advanced AI features to enhance the product's intelligence and user experience.

To make this happen you will:

Help design and implement the product architecture.
Collaborate with team members to re-build the application using TypeScript.
Design and ship AI features - prompts, evals, tool-use, agent flows - that genuinely change what the product can do for users.
Own meaningful slices of the product end-to-end - you'll make the calls, ship the work, and live with the results.
Work closely with the leadership team and our team of legal experts.




What you'll bring

8+ years building and shipping full-stack web products in production - ideally including at least one you took from zero to users.
A track record of accomplishments you're proud of - hard problems solved, products shipped.
Deep proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js and modern web development frameworks.
Strong data modelling instincts - you've designed schemas that survived contact with real users and changing requirements, not just queried existing ones.
A CS or engineering degree, or the equivalent depth picked up by building things - we care about how you think, not where you learned it.
Hands-on experience integrating LLMs into a product - prompts, evals, tool use, or agent flows. You don't need to have trained a model, but you should know what works and what doesn't in production.




Even better if you have;

Worked on a greenfield project or in an early-stage team, and know the difference between 'scrappy' and 'sloppy'.
Exposure to legal tech, SaaS products, or early-stage tech teams.
An interest in machine learning and building new AI models.




You are the type of person who embodies these traits

Communication. You're concise in speech and writing, and you collaborate openly and positively.
Motivation. You're driven to make a real difference through your work, and find genuine joy in seeing users benefit from what you create.
Pragmatic. You understand the trade-offs between quality and velocity, and consistently strike the right balance.
Curiosity. You constantly ask who, what, where, when and why, seeking deeper understanding and better solutions.

Settify is an inclusive, people-first company committed to breaking down institutional barriers that keep people from reaching their potential. If you meet some, but not all the requirements above, we encourage you to still submit your application.




Why join Settify?

Your work matters. Helping lawyers help people sits at the heart of everything we do. We solve real world problems that improve and support local, everyday law firms. So they can do their best work for the people in the communities they serve.
Make an impact. You won't be another ‘cog in the wheel' here. We give full trust and autonomy for you to be heard, to work on big & complex projects - and to make a real difference.

Grow your career with us. Our founder Christian Beck has been building legal tech businesses for over 30 years. There are opportunities galore to expand your career based on where your interests lie. We're not afraid to pivot based on market conditions - you will always have the opportunity to stay ahead of the curve and do your best work here.
Have fun with us. Celebrations. Socials. Sports teams. Access to sailing and yacht events.
We value your well-being - enjoy 2 additional paid wellbeing days every year, free gym membership, corporate dental plan and weekly massages in the office.
Work in a beautiful office space - with a catered lunch and breakfast every week and a fully stocked kitchen

The ArcelorMittal Global Solutions AI Team is a transversal Artificial Intelligence capability enabling business divisions to create measurable value through responsible, production-grade AI and data solutions. In the initial phase, you will design and build cloud-based backend and frontend software solutions yourself. Collaborate closely with AI, data, and cloud engineers during delivery

Review code and provide constructive feedback
Define and enforce development standards, best practices, and coding guidelines
Oversee technical quality, maintainability, and reliability of delivered software
Support planning, estimation, and technical decision-making


Cross-Functional Collaboration

Translate solution requirements into sound technical designs
Ensure alignment between software design and cloud / AI platform constraints


Required Skills & Experience

Core Technical Skills


Strong experience in full-stack software development (backend and frontend), preferably in cloud-based environments
Solid programming skills across backend and frontend technologies (e.g. Python, JavaScript/TypeScript)
Experience designing and building APIs and backend services
Good understanding of cloud-native architectures and deployment models
Experience with version control, testing, and CI/CD practices


Leadership & Ownership

Experience mentoring or guiding other developers (formal or informal)

Comfortable making technical decisions and trade-offs


Professional Experience

Experience working in cross-functional teams
Exposure to enterprise or complex system landscapes


Nice to Have


Experience building software that supports AI or data platforms
Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS)

What We Look For In This Role


A strong hands-on engineer who enjoys building real systems

A purely managerial or people-only role

With steel at our core, our inventive people and an entrepreneurial culture at heart, we will support the world in making that change. This is what we believe it takes to be the steel company of the future.

The team’s next phase is focused on establishing product-line standards, enabling versioned components, repeatable releases, multiple deployments and reliable engineering evidence outputs, with the longer-term ambition of developing a commercial-grade offering.

The team operates with direct communication, short decision paths and high individual ownership. Software is developed against real engineering models, test-bench hardware and campaign data, with physics models serving as the technical source of truth.




Role Purpose

The Senior Software Engineer – Simulation & Engineering Products will play a key role in developing and productizing the software backbone supporting propulsion and flight-vehicle research programmes within TII’s Propulsion & Space Research Centre.

The role sits within a small digital engineering team responsible for an operational engineering platform, physics-based simulation software, AI-enabled engineering tools, and an expanding hardware and test integration capability.

The successful candidate will be responsible for evolving these capabilities from programme-specific solutions into robust, maintainable and reusable software products built to product-line and commercial-grade standards. This includes establishing repeatable releases, versioned components, reliable deployment processes, stable APIs, test-evidence pipelines, and software that can support multiple programmes and future external applications.




Key Responsibilities

Software Product Engineering

Evolve the existing engineering platform from a single-deployment system into a configurable, maintainable and reusable product capable of supporting multiple programmes and, in the future, external customers.
Develop and enhance backend and frontend capabilities using technologies including Python/FastAPI and React.
Support platform capabilities covering requirements and system models, including SysML v2, test campaigns and results, risk and evidence registers, and interactive 3D visualization.
Improve overall product quality, including frontend experience, documentation, installation, upgrades, maintainability and security hardening.
Apply a strong product mindset to software architecture and development, considering users, roadmaps, maintainability and total cost of ownership.

CI/CD & Release Engineering

Own and enhance CI/CD and release-engineering practices across the product.
Develop automated build, test and deployment pipelines and comprehensive regression suites.
Establish reliable versioning and release-management practices.
Implement containerized deployments suitable for standard, offline and restricted-network environments.
Develop deployment documentation, operational runbooks and repeatable installation and upgrade processes.
Ensure releases are reliable, controlled and reproducible across deployments.

Numerical & Simulation Software

Support the engineering of physics-based software used as the technical source of truth, including:
Validated gas-turbine performance solvers.
Engine model adaptation using test data.
Compiled real-time engine models.
Extract existing model-adaptation and model-test correlation capabilities into independently versioned libraries with stable APIs.
Enable numerical libraries to be consumed through the platform backend, command-line interfaces and future engineering tools.
Apply appropriate software-engineering practices around scientific and numerical code, including tolerance-based testing, units management and floating-point considerations.
Work closely with physics and model-development specialists to ensure numerical models are integrated and used appropriately.

Test Data & Engineering Evidence

Design and develop pipelines for ingesting engineering and test data using formats including TDMS and HDF5.
Implement physics-based consistency and validation checks.
Develop traceable and reviewable engineering evidence outputs and reports.
Ensure test results and supporting evidence can be reliably linked to engineering models, requirements and programme activities.

Hardware & Real-Time Integration

Support software integration at the hardware boundary, including data acquisition systems, engine telemetry and real-time targets.
Contribute to the development and integration of a real-time hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) test capability.
Support high-rate data logging, time synchronization and reliable data transfer between acquisition systems, real-time systems and the engineering platform.

Engineering Quality & Collaboration

Act as a senior technical reviewer for software, architecture and engineering designs.
Conduct high-quality code reviews, identifying defects, maintainability concerns and opportunities for improvement.
Work closely with the platform’s Lead Engineer and other technical specialists within a small, highly autonomous engineering team.
Contribute to establishing and maintaining software-engineering standards across the team.
Use AI-assisted development tools where appropriate while maintaining robust human review, testing and evaluation controls.

Research & Publication

Contribute to research and technical publications where the work presents publishable outcomes.
Potential research areas include test-driven model adaptation, evaluation of grounded AI engineering assistants, and test-data engineering.




Qualifications

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
Advanced academic qualifications in a relevant engineering or scientific discipline would be advantageous.




Experience

Minimum 7 years of experience building and shipping production-grade software.
Demonstrated experience working with numerical, scientific, simulation or engineering software in domains such as aerospace, energy, automotive, scientific computing or quantitative finance.
Proven experience owning software through the full development lifecycle, including deployment, operation, maintenance and support.
Demonstrated experience shipping a software product, application, library or engineering tool through controlled and versioned releases.
Experience making and managing API decisions, breaking changes, upgrade paths, bug fixes and ongoing product maintenance.
Strong experience with CI/CD, DevOps, containerization, environment management, configuration management and release engineering.




Technical Competencies

Comfortable working alongside C/C++ codebases.

Job Description

Job Title: Solutions Engineer

Location: UAE

Company Overview

Quvia is the first AI-powered quality of experience (QoE) management platform for things that move, like ships and planes, transforming connectivity and digital experiences even in the most remote and hard-to-reach places. The Quvia platform uses AI and machine learning to seamlessly blend any combination of connectivity, regardless of provider, orbit or network, into one, vendor-neutral environment. It then delivers comprehensive, end-to-end analytics and dynamic network orchestration that optimizes for the best possible QoE and end-user experiences. Today, Quvia works with world-leading, Fortune 500 companies in aviation, cruise, shipping and more.

Why Quvia?


Founded in 2019, Quvia is a fast-growing, Series A tech startup passionate about making connectivity and digital experiences better for everyone, everywhere.
Our industry-first solutions are already addressing major challenges for companies in the aviation and cruise industries – and we're just getting started.
Quvia is headquartered in the greater Miami region, with offices in the UK and India, and remote teams around the world.
As an early-stage company, all Quvia employees have the opportunity to make a significant impact on our growth trajectory, and the future of the industries we serve.
Quvia is backed by Columbia Capital, a respected venture capital firm founded in 1989 that has raised over $5 Bn of fund commitments.


About The Role

The Solutions Engineer is the technical bridge between our customers and our engineering and operations teams, assessing a customer's current network, capturing new technical requirements and pain points, and converting them into solution designs that deliver measurable business outcomes. You will own the journey from qualification through proof of concept to production. This role demands deep networking fundamentals across terrestrial and satellite environments, hands-on expertise in software-defined networking (SDN) and multi-vendor SD-WAN technologies, scripting and DevOps capability, and the judgement to evaluate emerging technologies and design solutions that scale.

Working on this technology, you will have the opportunity to make a major impact on the implementation and quality of Quvia's next-generation products. Our environment cultivates innovation and rapid product iteration within a creative solution space, and we need a dedicated, organized, and efficient professional who thrives on being integral to a fast-paced startup. As an excellent communicator, you will set appropriate expectations, keep stakeholders apprised of progress and action items, manage project plans, balance workloads, and ensure we meet our commitments; all while navigating the complexities of large enterprise customers. Above all, you will think creatively through complex problems and design and implement solutions that address customer pain points and generate economic benefits, enabling us to publish a clear ROI for every customer.

What You’ll Do


Partner with sales to assess a customer’s current network, capture new technical requirements and pain points, and convert them into tailored solution designs with clear, measurable business outcomes.
Design, test and deploy multi path traffic orchestration systems across satellite, and terrestrial environments in customer networks using Quvia products and third party integrations. This will require the setup of a customer profile at edge, cloud and datacenters/POPs.
Lead proof of concepts end to end: define success criteria, design, hardware specifications, installation, configuration and testing of Quvia systems. Responsible for troubleshooting complex issues with customer, QA and Engineering teams, and own the handoff from POC to production.
Use scripting and DevOps practices to streamline solution delivery – configuration templating, workflow automation and tooling that supports demos, POCs and repeatable deployments.
Act as a technical advisor to customers, offering guidance on best practices and optimal usage of terrestrial and satellite communication systems, and presenting status updates and health metrics to customer stakeholders.
Conduct training sessions and workshops for customers and internal teams on the operation and maintenance of Quvia products and their value proposition.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including sales, product management, systems, engineering, QA, and service delivery, to ensure successful project execution. Develop and maintain comprehensive documentation for all solutions and services provided. Complete a successful handoff to all relevant teams at the end of the project.


What You'll Need


Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Telecommunications, Computer Science, or a related field.
At least 5 years of network engineering experience across terrestrial and/or satellite communications, including multi-link architecture.
Deep networking fundamentals, including routing and switching, network security, wireless, and datacenter networking.
Hands-on experience with software-defined networking (SDN) and multi-vendor SD-WAN and Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) platforms such as Fortinet, VMware VeloCloud, Cisco (Meraki/Viptela), Cradlepoint (Ericsson), Palo Alto, or similar enterprise solutions.
Scripting and DevOps experience in a networking context – Python, REST APIs, configuration orchestration, zero-touch provisioning and workflow automation.
A track record of leading customer-facing POCs, deployments or migrations (for example, from traditional WAN architectures to SD-WAN) in large enterprise environments.
Proven ability to convert a customer’s current network, new technical requirements and pain points into business outcomes, and to articulate that value to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Proven knowledge and understanding of managing virtual infrastructure using VMware vSphere, Hyper-V, or KVM, and a thorough understanding of computer hardware and operating systems.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the confidence to lead customer conversations at both engineering and executive level.
Commercial awareness: the ability to spot opportunities to reduce cost, simplify delivery, and open new market segments through better solution design.
Project management experience and the ability to handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
Satellite communication (SATCOM) systems knowledge and experience is a plus.
Experience with cloud-hosted networking and security (e.g. Azure- or AWS-hosted NGFW) is a plus.


What We'll Offer

Performance related bonus
Competitive Health Benefits including optical and dental plan
Pension Scheme

Paid Public Holidays
Share Options

Quvia will never ask job applicants or new hires to send money or deposit checks for the company. In case of doubt, please contact us directly at hr-recruitment@quvia.ai

About The Role

About US: Soar is a Saudi fintech startup that specializes in financing and investment. Currently headquartered in Saudi Arabia, Soar is growing throughout the region with a mission to help people achieve their financial goals with innovative financial and property investment solutions and tools through its multi-purpose platform, designed to offer a simple and seamless user experience.

The Mission:

Real estate is one of the largest, slowest-to-change markets on earth — trillions of dollars in transactions still run on fragmented data, manual workflows, and software that automates paperwork instead of doing the work. We believe that era is over. At Soar, we are building an agentic-first platform: products where AI agents don’t just assist people, they do the work — sourcing, analyzing, negotiating, coordinating, and closing — with humans setting direction and judgment. We are looking for a Chief Product Officer to define what that product is, build it from zero, and use it to fundamentally reinvent how real estate works. This is not a role for someone who wants to optimize an existing roadmap. It is for a builder who wants to create a category. What “agentic-first” means here

Most companies are bolting a chatbot onto legacy software. We are doing the opposite: designing the product around autonomous and semi-autonomous agents as the primary way work gets done, with interfaces, data, and trust models built to match. As CPO, you will own this thesis end to end.

What “agentic-first” means here:


Most companies are bolting a chatbot onto legacy software. We are doing the opposite: designing the product around autonomous and semi-autonomous agents as the primary way.
work gets done, with interfaces, data, and trust models built to match. As CPO, you will own this thesis end to end.
Agents as the core unit of the product, rather than features that wrap a model around old workflows.
Outcomes over interfaces — the product should accomplish outcomes, not just surface information.
Trust, transparency, and human-in-the-loop by design — designing for the moments
where the agent acts on the user’s behalf, and where the human stays in control.
Data and feedback as a moat — a learning loop where every transaction makes the next one smarter.


Requirements

What you’ll do:


Set the vision. Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for an agentic-first real estate platform — and the conviction behind it.
Build 0 to 1, then 1 to n. Take products from blank page to launch to scale. Define the first wedge, ship fast, learn faster, and expand.
Hire and lead the team. Recruit, lead, and grow a world-class product, design, and product-engineering culture from the ground up.
Push the technology. Work hands-on with frontier models, agent frameworks, and emerging tooling. Run experiments others consider too early or too risky.
Take real risks. Make bold, calculated bets with incomplete information — and own the outcomes, good or bad.
Be a force across the company. Partner with engineering, design, GTM, and leadership to align the company behind a coherent product strategy.
Stay obsessed with users. Talk to agents, brokers, buyers, sellers, and investors
constantly. Translate the messy reality of real estate into products people love.


Who you are:


A proven builder. You have built and shipped products that real people used, ideally including 0-to-1 work where you defined the problem, not just the solution.
Creative and unconventional. You think from first principles, question defaults, and are energized by problems with no established playbook.
Fluent in cutting-edge AI. You’ve worked with LLMs, agents, or applied AI in production— or you’ve gone deep enough to lead a team that does.
Comfortable with calculated risk. You take bold action, decide with conviction under uncertainty, and treat smart failures as the cost of moving fast.
Strategic and hands-on. You can set strategy and dive into the details — prototypes, specs, prompts, data, and metrics.
A magnet for talent. You inspire great people to do the best work of their careers, and you raise the bar on everyone around you.
High velocity. You move with urgency, communicate with clarity, and care more about impact than process.


Bonus points:


Experience fintech, marketplaces, Agentic Applications, and AI Research and R&D space.
Founder or early-stage operator experience.
A technical background or the ability to go toe-to-toe with engineers on agent architecture.
A portfolio of products, prototypes, or experiments we can see and play with.


Why this role:


You will be a founding member of the leadership team, with the mandate and ownership to shape the product, the team, and the company. The market is enormous, the timing for agentic AI is now, and the upside — in impact and in equity — is real.
If you want to build something that changes an entire industry, and you’re willing to bet boldly to do it, we should talk.

Senior Solutions Architect (Post-Sales)

Venture-backed AI Infrastructure Scale-up

As Senior Solutions Architect, you'll be the technical partner enterprise customers rely on to deploy, run, and scale demanding AI/ML workloads on a modern GPU-accelerated platform. This is a hands-on, customer-facing role: you'll own complex deployments from first workshop to production, and turn tangled infrastructure requirements into architecture that actually holds up under load.




Day to day you'll work alongside platform engineering, MLOps, data science, and infrastructure teams, guiding them through onboarding, tuning workload performance, and keeping large GPU clusters reliable and cost-efficient. When production misbehaves, you're the one leading the investigation and getting things back on track.




It's a rare seat at a company operating right at the centre of the AI buildout, working with the frameworks and silicon most engineers only read about. If you're equally at home designing a multi-tenant ML platform, running a proof-of-concept, and troubleshooting distributed training performance at 2am, I'd like to hear from you.




What you'll do & achieve

Design end-to-end AI/ML platform architectures across inference, training, and data pipelines
Build reference architectures for GPU cluster deployment, model serving, and multi-tenant ML infrastructure
Evaluate and recommend inference serving frameworks (vLLM, TGI, Triton, and similar)
Advise on GPU fabric topology for distributed training (NVLink, InfiniBand, RoCEv2)

Deliver technical presentations, workshops, and proof-of-concept engagements
Act as the primary technical advisor and escalation point for your enterprise accounts
Monitor and troubleshoot production: GPU utilisation, workload performance, cluster health, and cost
Lead root cause analysis and remediation on the hard, cross-team issues
Feed insight back to Product and Engineering to influence platform capability and roadmap
Document reference architectures and implementation guides, and mentor others as the team grows




Who you are

8+ years in infrastructure, platform, or solutions engineering, with 3+ years focused on AI/ML infrastructure or MLOps
Deep Kubernetes expertise: cluster lifecycle, workloads, operators, RBAC

jobs.description:
INSPIRE | EXHILARATE | DELIGHT

For over seven decades, Chalhoub Group has been a partner and creator of luxury experiences in the Middle East. In its pursuit to excel as a hybrid luxury retailer, the Group has curated a portfolio of over 10 owned brands and strengthened its distribution and marketing expertise for over 400 international names across luxury fashion, beauty, jewellery, watches, eyewear, and art de vivre categories.

Every step at Chalhoub Group is taken to build a future where luxury dreams become reality — bridging cultures and crafting memorable experiences for our consumers. Be it by constantly reinventing itself, committing to innovation, or embracing new technologies, the Group is shaping the future of luxury retail. It delivers seamless omnichannel experiences across more than 950 stores, online platforms, and mobile apps. Driving this innovation journey is The Greenhouse — the Group’s innovation hub, incubator, and accelerator for startups and emerging businesses, regionally and globally.

Chalhoub Group fosters a people-at-heart culture rooted in diversity, equity, and inclusion, and a workplace catalysed by forward thinking and future-proofing. Today, it brings together over 16,000 talented professionals across eight countries in the Middle East, with a presence in LATAM.

Sustainability is at the core of the Group’s strategy, guided by a clear commitment to people, partners, and the planet. Chalhoub Group is proud to be a member of the United Nations Global Compact, a signatory of the Women’s Empowerment Principles, and to have pledged to reach Net Zero by 2040.

What You'll Be Doing

We are looking for a Server-Side Swift Developer to join the backend team at Level Shoes. The team builds and operates the Vapor-based microservices that power our iOS, Android and web storefronts across six GCC markets in English and Arabic. This is a hands-on senior role with real production ownership. You will design, build, review and ship backend services, and you will be accountable for how they behave in production — including under sale-day load and when the systems we integrate with misbehave.


Design, develop and maintain scalable backend services in Swift using Vapor.
Own services end to end: design, implementation, code review, deployment and production health.
Build and maintain the RESTful APIs behind customer-facing commerce flows — accounts and


authentication, catalogue, cart, checkout, payments and orders.


Ensure correctness across multiple stores and languages, where every request is scoped to a market and a locale.
Design and maintain integrations with third-party systems — commerce platform, order management, search, CMS, and payment/BNPL gateways — including webhook handling and safe degradation when those systems are slow or unavailable.
Build concurrency-safe, idempotent processing for operations that run across multiple service replicas and must never be applied twice.
Model data and optimise queries in MongoDB; implement caching and session strategies in Redis.
Implement and tune Elastic Search-backed search and listing functionality.
Ship behaviour changes behind feature flags with staged, measured rollouts.
Investigate production issues from logs and metrics, and validate fixes with evidence.
Maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows on Kubernetes.
Explore AI-driven capabilities such as vector search for personalisation.
Review teammates' changes; all code is reviewed before merge regardless of seniority.


What You’ll Need To Succeed


6+ years of professional software development experience, including at least 3 years building


production backend services in server-side Swift (Vapor). Client-side Swift alone does not satisfy

this requirement — the role requires Swift running on a server, under load, with a database behind it.

Prior iOS/macOS or backend experience in other languages is welcome for the remaining years.


Strong command of Swift concurrency, protocol-oriented design and Codable, including decoding


payloads from external systems.


Demonstrable experience with concurrency, race conditions and idempotency in services running as multiple instances — a specific production bug you found, diagnosed and fixed, not theoretical


knowledge.


Strong understanding of RESTful API design, authentication and token lifecycle.
MongoDB in production, including data modelling, indexing and query performance.
Redis for caching and session state, including graceful behaviour when it is unavailable.
ElasticSearch for search and listing.
Experience integrating payment gateways and third-party APIs, including webhook-driven flows.
Kubernetes: deploying and operating containerised services, and reading logs and metrics to a


defensible conclusion.


Git, CI/CD pipelines and automated testing; Swift Package Manager for dependency management.
Strong grasp of performance, scalability and security best practices.
E-commerce, payments or another domain where defects have direct financial consequences.
Integration experience with Magento or a comparable commerce platform, or with an order


management system.


Multi-tenant or multi-region systems where data isolation is a correctness requirement.
Localisation beyond string swapping, including right-to-left languages.
AWS or another cloud platform for hosting backend services.
Logging and monitoring tools such as New Relic, used for investigation rather than dashboards alone.
Feature-flagging and progressive rollout platforms.
Jenkins and Gerrit.
Agile development methodologies.


What We Can Offer You

With us, you will turn your aspirations into reality. We will help shape your journey through enriching experiences, learning and development opportunities and exposure to different assignments within your role or through internal mobility. Our Group offers diverse career paths for those who are extraordinary, every day.

We recognise the value that you bring, and we strive to provide a competitive benefits package which includes health care, child education contribution, remote and flexible working policies as well as exclusive employee discounts.

Using GenAI in Your Application Process

To support a fair and consistent experience for all candidates, we ask that assessments and interviews are completed independently and without assistance from generative AI tools. This ensures we understand your strengths, your thinking, and how you approach real situations.

We Invite All Applicants to Apply

It Takes Diversity Of Thought, Culture, Background, Differing Abilities and Perspectives to truly Inspire, Exhilarate and Delight our customers. At Chalhoub Group, we are committed to inclusion and diversity.

We welcome all applicants to apply and be part of our exciting future. We ensure equal opportunity for all our applicants without regard to gender, age, race, religion, national origin or disability status.

Our community spans 45,000+ engineers across 55+ countries; join a culture where great people stay, grow, and thrive (and love eating kake!).




We’re looking for Senior Software Engineers specializing in Node.js/React, skilled in building high-performance, scalable systems that support millions of users, and committed to solid architectural judgment and engineering best practices. Build and ship production features end-to-end across Node.js backends and React frontends, owning your work from implementation through deployment.

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

Workflow automation and AI features that solve real business problems

Own on-site conversion end to end for a $1Billion+ e-commerce brand. Find where the revenue is leaking, and decide what changes.




Up to AED 37,000/month (tax-free) + monthly performance bonus of up to 25% of base




Location: Dubai, UAE (On-site) with relocation assistance and visa support




Growth path from here is Director of Conversion & Experimentation → fluid scope at the intersection of experimentation, merchandising strategy, and site revenue ownership. What takes 4-5 years elsewhere happens in 1-2 here.




We've been AI-first since December 2023: session recordings and heatmap data run through AI summarisation before a hypothesis is written, and test concepts are generated and pressure-tested with AI before they reach Design. You'd be building on a foundation, not evangelising one.




Role Overview

Puffy, a market-leading, nine-figure D2C brand and Top 5 US mattress brand with over $1Billion in sales, is hiring a Senior CRO Manager to own on-site conversion rate optimization with authority over the experimentation roadmap, UX and merchandising direction, purchase-journey design, and the optimization backlog, reporting directly to the VP Digital Experience & Conversion.




This role exists to convert behavioural and quantitative data into revenue the business can bank, building the hypothesis pipeline, testing standards, and prioritisation system that let conversion improve without executive attention on every decision. It is a senior individual-contributor seat with no direct reports, where influence comes from evidence.




The Problems You'll Own:

Primary: Grow conversion on a site that already converts: A three-person analytics team owns the data infrastructure and pipelines, so tracking and reporting are already built — you start with clean data, not six months of tagging. The site receives high traffic supported by $2M+/month in digital advertising, but test duration depends on eligible traffic, conversion rates, and the size of the effect being measured and a tenth of a percent is material revenue — but mattresses are high-consideration, signal per visitor is thin, and a premium brand standard sets the bar every test has to clear. The problem is deciding what to test, in what order, and being right often enough that Revenue Per Visitor moves.
Secondary: Make the commercial levers earn their place: Pricing presentation, comparisons, bundles, upsells, promotional messaging, trust signals, and risk reversal have the most direct line to Revenue Per Visitor, and are most often set by habit, not evidence. Each carries a brand cost if pushed too hard on a premium product. The work is establishing which of them move a high-consideration buyer, and at what intensity.




The Career Accelerator

This is not a role where you run someone else's backlog, wait on a roadmap you didn't write, and report results after the decision was made. The scope is scarce: very few Senior CRO Managers own the experimentation roadmap, UX and merchandising direction, pricing and promotional psychology, and the commercial outcome at once, with a direct line to the VP Digital Experience & Conversion and no layers in between.




Your first 12 months: build the prioritized optimization backlog and the logic that ranks it. Run the experimentation roadmap end to end — hypothesis, experiment design, implementation, QA, launch, analysis, validation. Rebuild the mobile purchase journey around viewport priority, information hierarchy, and progressive disclosure. Restructure pricing, comparisons, bundles, upsells, trust signals, and risk reversal against conversion evidence. Set the testing standards Design and Development work against. Cross-reference paid-media performance against on-site behaviour to find where the next conversion opportunity sits. Shape the future of conversion optimization at Puffy, where on-site performance decides the return on $2M+/month in digital advertising.




What Is In It For You

This isn't just another CRO role. This is your chance to become a true industry architect.




Full Ownership of the Conversion Agenda

You set the optimization agenda, build the testing system, and own the commercial outcomes.

You decide what gets tested and in what order, design the experiments, and direct Design and Development on layout, hierarchy, imagery, and interaction. The backlog is yours, and so is the reasoning behind it.
You're accountable for conversion rate and Revenue Per Visitor rather than test volume, and you present the evidence behind every recommendation to senior leadership. Diagnosis comes before prescription.




Join a High-Performance Organization and Partner with the 1%:

🏆 Puffy: Top 5 Mattress Brand in US with Over $1Billion USD in Sales

🌍 Great Place to Work Certified

💡 Work directly with Forbes Council Member CEO. Your vision is the company's vision.

Gain firsthand exposure to strategic decisions and high-velocity execution that drives a global brand




Experience a World-Class Lifestyle

Dubai offers a tax-free salary, world-class infrastructure, year-round sunshine, and a global lifestyle that most professionals only experience later in their careers. Your entire compensation package lands in your account — no deductions, no surprises.




Become the CRO Operator Other DTC Brands Try to Hire

In most companies, conversion specialists inherit a backlog somebody else prioritised and spend three years defending flat results. Here you build it. When the business decides where site revenue comes from next quarter, your evidence is the input to that decision, not a report on it afterwards. You'll leave with an experimentation system you designed end to end, and proof that it moved Revenue Per Visitor on a high-traffic, high-consideration site — the part almost nobody in this function can show. Puffy has been AI-First since December 2023, so you'll build it with an AI-native toolbox behind you rather than a queue of unprioritised test requests in front of you.

5+ years of hands-on CRO and e-commerce analytics in high-traffic environments, with measurable revenue impact from experimentation.

A focus on continuous growth.

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families.
